description:
List observations from Langfuse with optional filters and pagination.

Returns a summary of each observation: id, traceId, type, name, model, timing, level, and usage/cost metrics. The input and output fields are omitted from the list view for brevity — use get_observation with a specific observation ID to see the full I/O.

Typically used with traceId filter to list all observations within a specific trace. Can also be used to search across all traces by type, level, etc.

Any field value exceeding 1000 characters is automatically truncated and saved to a /tmp file. The truncated text includes the file path — use grep on that file to search within large values.

**Pagination:** Use page and limit to paginate. Response includes meta.totalItems and meta.totalPages.

fromStartTime.description: Only include observations with startTime on or after this ISO 8601 datetime.

level.description: Filter by observation level: DEBUG, DEFAULT, WARNING, or ERROR.

limit.description: Number of observations per page (1-100). Default: 10.

parentObservationId.description: Filter by parent observation ID to get direct children.

toStartTime.description: Only include observations with startTime before this ISO 8601 datetime.

traceId.description: Filter by trace ID. This is the most common filter — use it to get all observations for a specific trace.

type.description: Filter by observation type: GENERATION, SPAN, or EVENT.

name: get_observations
